‭BUREAU OF INDIAN STANDARDS‬ ‭(CENTRAL MARKS DEPARTMENT - I)‬

‭Our Ref: CMD-I/2:16:6‬ ‭23 July 2024‬

‭ ubject:‬ ‭Guidelines‬ ‭for‬ ‭surveillance‬ ‭during‬ ‭operation‬ ‭of‬ ‭Certificate‬‭of‬‭Conformity‬‭for‬ S ‭Stampings/‬ ‭Laminations/cores‬ ‭of‬ ‭transformers‬ ‭(with‬ ‭or‬ ‭without‬ ‭winding)‬ ‭under‬ ‭the‬ ‭conformity‬ ‭assessment‬ ‭Scheme‬ ‭–‬ ‭IV‬ ‭of‬ ‭Schedule‬ ‭–‬ ‭II‬ ‭of‬ ‭BIS‬‭(Conformity‬‭Assessment)‬ ‭Regulations, 2018‬

‭1)‬ ‭ his‬ ‭document‬ ‭stipulates‬ ‭the‬ ‭guidelines‬ ‭for‬ ‭surveillance‬ ‭by‬ ‭BIS‬ ‭with‬ ‭respect‬ ‭to‬ T ‭monitoring‬ ‭the‬ ‭operation‬ ‭of‬ ‭Certificates‬ ‭of‬ ‭Conformity‬ ‭(CoC)‬ ‭granted‬ ‭by‬ ‭BIS‬ ‭to‬ ‭manufacturers‬ ‭of‬ ‭Stampings/laminations/‬ ‭cores‬ ‭of‬ ‭transformers‬ ‭(with‬ ‭or‬ ‭without‬ ‭winding).‬

‭2)‬ ‭ hese‬‭guidelines‬‭are‬‭to‬‭be‬‭read‬‭in‬‭conjunction‬‭with‬‭the‬‭BIS‬‭Act,‬‭2016;‬‭BIS‬‭Rules,‬‭2018‬ T ‭and‬‭BIS‬‭(Conformity‬‭Assessment)‬‭Regulations,‬‭2018‬‭and‬‭guidelines‬‭framed‬‭thereunder,‬ ‭as‬ ‭per‬‭Scheme–IV‬‭of‬‭Schedule–II‬‭of‬‭these‬‭regulations‬‭as‬‭well‬‭as‬‭any‬‭Product‬‭Specific‬ ‭Guidelines‬ ‭for‬ ‭grant‬ ‭of‬ ‭certificate‬ ‭of‬ ‭conformity‬ ‭for‬ ‭Stampings/‬‭Laminations/cores‬‭of‬ ‭transformers‬ ‭(with‬ ‭or‬ ‭without‬ ‭winding)‬ ‭under‬ ‭Scheme‬ ‭-‬ ‭IV‬ ‭of‬ ‭Schedule‬ ‭-‬ ‭II‬ ‭of‬ ‭BIS‬ ‭(Conformity Assessment) Regulations, 2018.‬

‭3)‬ ‭ he‬ ‭intent‬ ‭of‬ ‭surveillance‬ ‭in‬ ‭case‬ ‭of‬ ‭this‬ ‭product‬ ‭is‬ ‭to‬ ‭check‬ ‭for‬ ‭compliance‬ ‭to‬ ‭the‬ T ‭essential‬‭requirement‬‭for‬‭this‬‭product‬‭mandated‬‭in‬‭the‬‭Steel‬‭and‬‭Steel‬‭Products‬‭(Quality‬ ‭Control)‬ ‭Order,‬ ‭2020‬ ‭i.e.‬ ‭that‬ ‭Stampings/laminations/cores‬ ‭of‬ ‭transformers‬ ‭(with‬ ‭or‬ ‭without‬ ‭winding)‬ ‭shall‬ ‭be‬ ‭made‬ ‭from‬ ‭BIS‬ ‭standard‬ ‭marked‬ ‭Grain‬ ‭Oriented‬‭Electrical‬ ‭Steel‬‭Sheet‬‭and‬‭Strip‬‭conforming‬‭to‬‭IS‬‭3024:2015‬‭or‬‭Cold‬‭rolled‬‭non-oriented‬‭electrical‬ ‭steel‬‭sheet‬‭and‬‭strip‬‭conforming‬‭to‬‭IS‬‭648:2006‬‭or‬‭Fe‬‭based‬‭amorphous‬‭strip‬‭delivered‬ ‭in the semi-processed state conforming to IS 16585:2016.‬

‭4)‬ ‭ he‬ ‭primary‬ ‭mode‬ ‭of‬ ‭surveillance‬ ‭in‬ ‭this‬ ‭case‬ ‭is‬ ‭factory‬ ‭surveillance‬‭i.e.‬‭visits‬‭to‬‭the‬ T ‭manufacturing‬ ‭units‬ ‭which‬ ‭are‬ ‭holding‬ ‭CoC.‬ ‭These‬ ‭surveillance‬ ‭visits‬ ‭may‬ ‭be‬ ‭conducted‬ ‭by‬ ‭the‬ ‭BIS‬ ‭certification‬ ‭officer‬ ‭or‬ ‭technical‬ ‭auditor‬ ‭of‬ ‭empanelled‬ ‭agency‬ ‭through‬ ‭CSMD.‬ ‭However,‬ ‭as‬ ‭far‬ ‭as‬ ‭possible,‬ ‭it‬ ‭is‬ ‭preferable‬ ‭that‬ ‭surveillance‬ ‭visits‬ ‭especially‬ ‭under‬ ‭Scheme-IV‬ ‭are‬ ‭carried‬ ‭out‬ ‭by‬ ‭the‬ ‭BIS‬ ‭certification‬ ‭officer‬ ‭at‬ ‭the‬ ‭concerned BO.‬

‭5)‬ ‭During the surveillance visit, the following actions shall be taken up:‬

 ‭(i)‬ P ‭ hysical‬ ‭verification‬ ‭of‬ ‭availability‬ ‭of‬ ‭ISI‬ ‭marked‬ ‭material‬ ‭and‬ ‭dispatch‬ ‭of‬ ‭stampings/lamination/cores under CoC‬

 ‭(a)‬ ‭During‬ ‭the‬ ‭visit,‬ ‭the‬ ‭labels‬ ‭on‬ ‭the‬ ‭ISI‬ ‭Marked‬ ‭material‬ ‭available‬ ‭shall‬ ‭be‬ ‭physically‬ ‭verified‬ ‭to‬ ‭check‬ ‭that‬ ‭the‬ ‭material‬ ‭has‬‭been‬‭manufactured‬‭by‬‭a‬‭BIS‬ ‭license holder holding a valid licence.‬

 ‭1‬

‭(b)‬‭In‬ ‭addition,‬ ‭the‬ ‭thickness‬ ‭of‬ ‭the‬ ‭coil‬ ‭of‬ ‭ISI‬ ‭marked‬ ‭electrical‬ ‭steel/material‬‭as‬ ‭well‬‭as‬‭the‬‭thickness‬‭of‬‭the‬‭stampings/laminations‬ ‭made‬‭from‬‭said‬‭ISI‬‭marked‬ ‭material shall be checked to verify the traceability.‬

 ‭(c)‬ ‭In‬ ‭addition,‬‭materials‬‭being‬‭dispatched‬‭shall‬‭be‬‭checked‬‭to‬‭ensure‬‭that‬‭they‬‭are‬ ‭being‬ ‭sent‬ ‭with‬ ‭valid‬ ‭CoC‬ ‭bearing‬ ‭the‬ ‭assigned‬ ‭CoC‬ ‭Number‬ ‭with‬ ‭test‬ ‭certificate.‬

 ‭(ii)‬ ‭Verification of traceability through records‬

 ‭(a)‬ ‭As‬ ‭per‬ ‭product‬ ‭specific‬ ‭guidelines‬ ‭for‬ ‭grant‬ ‭of‬ ‭CoC,‬ ‭Holder‬ ‭of‬ ‭certificate‬ ‭of‬ ‭conformity‬ ‭is‬ ‭required‬ ‭to‬ ‭submit‬ ‭to‬ ‭the‬ ‭concerned‬ ‭BO‬ ‭the‬ ‭details‬ ‭of‬ ‭electrical‬ ‭steel‬‭purchased‬‭and‬‭consumed‬‭by‬‭them,‬‭enclosing‬‭the‬‭Mill‬‭Test‬‭Certificates‬‭and‬ ‭also‬ ‭the‬ ‭details‬ ‭of‬ ‭Stampings/‬‭laminations/‬‭cores‬‭of‬‭transformers‬‭manufactured‬ ‭and‬ ‭dispatched‬ ‭by‬ ‭them‬ ‭from‬ ‭this‬ ‭steel,‬‭on‬‭a‬‭quarterly‬‭basis.‬ ‭These‬‭submitted‬ ‭records‬ ‭shall‬ ‭be‬ ‭cross‬ ‭checked‬ ‭with‬ ‭the‬ ‭records‬ ‭available‬ ‭in‬ ‭the‬ ‭factory‬ ‭for‬ ‭conformity.‬

 ‭(b)‬‭The compliance to the defined Inspection and Testing Plan shall be checked.‬

 ‭(c)‬ ‭Details‬ ‭of‬ ‭raw‬ ‭material‬ ‭purchase/consumption‬ ‭and‬‭production/dispatch‬‭records‬ ‭as‬ ‭declared‬ ‭by‬ ‭the‬ ‭CoC‬ ‭holder‬ ‭shall‬ ‭be‬ ‭verified‬ ‭to‬ ‭check‬ ‭that‬ ‭only‬ ‭electrical‬ ‭steel/material‬ ‭manufactured‬ ‭by‬ ‭a‬ ‭BIS‬ ‭license‬ ‭holder‬ ‭holding‬ ‭valid‬ ‭licence‬ ‭is‬ ‭being‬ ‭used‬ ‭to‬ ‭manufacture‬ ‭the‬ ‭product‬ ‭and‬ ‭also‬ ‭that‬ ‭the‬ ‭product‬ ‭is‬ ‭being‬ ‭dispatched under the valid CoC with a test certificate.‬

‭6)‬ ‭ ertification,‬ ‭Surveillance‬ ‭and‬ ‭Monitoring‬ ‭Department‬ ‭(CSMD)‬ ‭shall‬ ‭prepare‬ ‭and‬ C ‭circulate‬‭the‬‭plan‬‭for‬‭domestic‬‭surveillance‬‭in‬‭case‬‭of‬‭this‬‭product.‬‭The‬‭inspection‬‭and‬ ‭surveillance‬ ‭activities‬ ‭of‬ ‭foreign‬ ‭manufacturers‬ ‭shall‬ ‭be‬ ‭planned‬ ‭and‬ ‭prepared‬ ‭by‬ ‭Foreign‬ ‭Manufacturers‬ ‭Certification‬ ‭Department‬ ‭(FMCD)‬ ‭with‬ ‭approval‬ ‭of‬ ‭the‬ ‭competent‬ ‭authority.‬ ‭The‬ ‭factory‬ ‭inspection‬ ‭and‬ ‭surveillance‬ ‭activities‬ ‭of‬ ‭foreign‬ ‭manufacturers‬ ‭(and‬‭domestic‬‭manufacturers,‬‭till‬‭further‬‭orders)‬‭shall‬‭be‬‭undertaken‬‭by‬ ‭certification officers of BIS.‬

‭7)‬ ‭ enerally,‬ ‭one‬ ‭surveillance‬ ‭visit‬ ‭per‬ ‭year‬ ‭may‬ ‭be‬ ‭carried‬ ‭out‬ ‭for‬ ‭each‬ ‭manufacturing‬ G ‭unit‬ ‭holding‬ ‭a‬ ‭certificate‬ ‭of‬ ‭conformity.‬ ‭For‬ ‭any‬ ‭special‬ ‭inspection‬ ‭visit‬ ‭(other‬ ‭than‬ ‭surveillance‬ ‭and‬ ‭complaint‬ ‭investigation),‬ ‭the‬ ‭inspection‬ ‭charges‬ ‭of‬ ‭₹‬ ‭7,000‬ ‭shall‬ ‭be‬ ‭taken in advance.‬

‭8)‬ ‭ ill‬ ‭the‬ ‭time‬ ‭web/mobile‬‭application‬‭based‬‭module‬‭for‬‭surveillance‬‭is‬‭updated‬‭for‬‭this‬ T ‭product,‬‭surveillance‬‭visits‬‭under‬‭Scheme-IV‬‭shall‬‭be‬‭reported‬‭with‬‭requisite‬‭details‬‭in‬ ‭the‬ ‭presently‬ ‭available‬ ‭space‬ ‭fields‬ ‭of‬ ‭web/mobile‬ ‭application.‬ ‭The‬ ‭remaining‬ ‭places‬ ‭may‬‭be‬‭left‬‭blank‬‭or‬‭filled‬‭as‬‭Not‬‭applicable.‬‭At‬‭the‬‭end‬‭of‬‭the‬‭report,‬‭any‬‭other‬‭should‬ ‭be‬‭selected‬‭and‬‭scanned‬‭pages‬‭of‬‭inspection/factory‬‭test‬‭reports‬‭are‬‭to‬‭be‬‭uploaded.‬‭The‬ ‭reporting template for guidance is enclosed as‬‭Annexure - I‬‭.‬

 ‭2‬

‭9)‬ ‭The surveillance inspection may be deemed unsatisfactory in the following situations‬

 ‭(i)‬ U ‭ se‬ ‭of‬ ‭non‬ ‭ISI‬ ‭marked‬ ‭material‬ ‭to‬ ‭manufacture‬ ‭Stampings/laminations/‬ ‭cores‬ ‭of‬ ‭transformers‬

 ‭(a)‬ ‭If‬ ‭there‬ ‭is‬ ‭sufficient‬ ‭evidence‬ ‭(through‬ ‭physical‬ ‭verification,‬ ‭verification‬ ‭of‬ ‭records‬‭or‬‭combination‬‭thereof)‬‭that‬‭the‬‭CoC‬‭holder‬‭has‬‭used‬‭non‬‭ISI‬‭marked‬ ‭material‬ ‭to‬ ‭manufacture‬ ‭Stampings/laminations/‬ ‭cores‬ ‭of‬‭transformers‬‭and/or‬ ‭supplied this product without the valid CoC with a test certificate.‬

 ‭(b)‬‭In‬‭such‬‭cases,‬‭review‬‭of‬‭performance‬‭of‬‭the‬‭CoC‬‭holder‬‭shall‬‭be‬‭taken‬‭up‬‭and‬ ‭based‬‭on‬‭the‬‭same,‬‭the‬‭CoC‬‭may‬‭be‬‭placed‬‭under‬‭suspension‬‭by‬‭the‬‭Head‬‭BO.‬ ‭Simultaneously,‬ ‭a‬ ‭show-cause‬ ‭notice‬ ‭shall‬ ‭be‬ ‭issued‬ ‭to‬ ‭the‬ ‭CoC‬ ‭holder‬ ‭informing‬ ‭them‬ ‭that‬ ‭BIS‬ ‭intends‬ ‭to‬ ‭pursue‬ ‭legal‬ ‭action‬ ‭against‬ ‭them‬ ‭for‬ ‭violation‬ ‭of‬‭the‬‭QCO‬‭and‬‭giving‬‭them‬‭15‬‭days‬‭time‬‭to‬‭establish‬‭that‬‭they‬‭did‬ ‭not‬‭violate‬‭the‬‭QCO‬‭(personal‬‭hearing‬‭may‬‭be‬‭granted).‬‭(template‬‭for‬‭guidance‬ ‭enclosed‬‭as‬‭Annexure‬‭-‬‭II‬‭)‬‭Revocation‬‭of‬‭suspension‬‭may‬‭be‬‭considered‬‭once‬ ‭the‬ ‭CoC‬ ‭holder‬ ‭is‬ ‭able‬ ‭to‬ ‭establish‬ ‭that‬ ‭they‬ ‭did‬ ‭not‬ ‭violate‬ ‭QCO.‬ ‭If‬ ‭not,‬ ‭suspension may be followed by initiation of cancellation proceedings.‬

 ‭(ii)‬ ‭Noncompliance to SIT and minor discrepancies in records etc.‬

 ‭(a)‬ ‭In‬ ‭case‬ ‭deviation‬ ‭from‬ ‭prescribed‬ ‭SIT‬ ‭or‬ ‭minor‬ ‭discrepancies‬ ‭is‬‭observed‬‭in‬ ‭records‬ ‭but‬‭which‬‭does‬‭not‬‭constitute‬‭sufficient‬‭evidence‬‭that‬‭the‬‭CoC‬‭holder‬ ‭has‬ ‭used‬ ‭non‬ ‭ISI‬ ‭marked‬ ‭material‬ ‭to‬ ‭manufacture‬ ‭Stampings/laminations/‬ ‭cores‬‭of‬‭transformers‬‭and/or‬‭supplied‬‭this‬‭product‬‭without‬‭the‬‭valid‬‭CoC‬‭with‬ ‭a‬‭test‬‭certificate,‬‭the‬‭CoC‬‭holder‬‭shall‬‭be‬‭advised‬‭to‬‭take‬‭corrective‬‭actions‬‭and‬ ‭inform‬ ‭within‬ ‭prescribed‬ ‭time‬ ‭limit‬ ‭(normally‬ ‭not‬ ‭more‬ ‭than‬ ‭15‬ ‭days).‬ ‭(template for guidance enclosed as‬‭Annexure - III‬‭)‬

 ‭(b)‬‭In‬ ‭such‬ ‭cases,‬ ‭if‬ ‭it‬ ‭is‬ ‭observed‬ ‭that‬ ‭the‬ ‭CoC‬ ‭holder‬ ‭has‬ ‭not‬ ‭taken‬ ‭sufficient‬ ‭corrective‬ ‭actions,‬ ‭the‬ ‭case‬ ‭may‬ ‭be‬ ‭processed‬ ‭for‬ ‭imposition‬ ‭of‬ ‭suspension.‬ ‭Before‬ ‭imposition‬ ‭of‬ ‭suspension,‬ ‭a‬ ‭notice‬ ‭shall‬ ‭be‬ ‭issued‬ ‭by‬ ‭the‬ ‭Head‬ ‭BO‬ ‭seeking‬ ‭explanation‬ ‭from‬ ‭CoC‬ ‭holder‬ ‭giving‬ ‭10‬ ‭days‬ ‭time‬ ‭from‬ ‭the‬ ‭date‬ ‭of‬ ‭issuance of the notice. (template for guidance enclosed as‬‭Annexure - IV‬‭)‬

 ‭(A)‬ I‭ n‬ ‭case‬ ‭no‬ ‭reply‬ ‭is‬ ‭received‬ ‭within‬ ‭the‬ ‭stipulated‬ ‭time,‬ ‭the‬ ‭suspension‬ ‭shall be imposed.‬

 ‭(B)‬ I‭ n‬‭case‬‭reply‬‭is‬‭received‬‭within‬‭stipulated‬‭time,‬‭it‬‭shall‬‭be‬‭examined‬‭and‬ ‭reviewed‬‭by‬‭the‬‭Head‬‭BO.‬‭If‬‭the‬‭reply‬‭received‬‭is‬‭satisfactory‬‭informing‬ ‭all‬ ‭the‬ ‭requisite‬ ‭corrective‬ ‭actions‬ ‭have‬ ‭been‬ ‭taken‬ ‭by‬ ‭CoC‬ ‭holder,‬‭the‬ ‭case‬ ‭shall‬ ‭be‬ ‭taken‬ ‭up‬ ‭for‬ ‭verification‬ ‭of‬ ‭corrective‬ ‭actions‬ ‭through‬ ‭immediate surveillance visit preferably within the next 20 days.‬

 ‭3‬

‭(C)‬ I‭ n‬ ‭case‬ ‭during‬ ‭the‬ ‭first‬ ‭surveillance‬ ‭visit‬ ‭after‬ ‭issuing‬ ‭the‬ ‭notice‬ ‭for‬ ‭suspension,‬ ‭it‬ ‭is‬ ‭observed‬ ‭that‬ ‭the‬ ‭corrective‬ ‭actions‬ ‭have‬ ‭not‬ ‭been‬ ‭implemented‬ ‭by‬ ‭the‬ ‭CoC‬ ‭holder,‬ ‭the‬ ‭case‬ ‭may‬ ‭be‬ ‭processed‬ ‭for‬ ‭imposition of suspension without any further notice.‬

 ‭(D)‬ I‭ n‬‭case‬‭reply‬‭received‬‭is‬‭partial‬‭or‬‭incomplete,‬‭the‬‭case‬‭may‬‭be‬‭processed‬ ‭for imposition of suspension without any further notice.‬

 ‭(c)‬ ‭The‬‭decision‬‭to‬‭impose‬‭suspension‬‭shall‬‭be‬‭communicated‬‭to‬‭the‬‭CoC‬‭holder.‬ ‭(template‬‭for‬‭guidance‬‭enclosed‬‭as‬‭Annexure‬‭-‬‭V‬‭)‬‭Suspension‬‭may‬‭be‬‭revoked‬ ‭after verification of corrective actions undertaken by the manufacturer.‬

‭10)‬ (‭ i)‬‭The‬‭BOs‬‭may‬‭arrange‬‭visit(s)‬‭as‬‭given‬‭below‬‭to‬‭check‬‭compliance‬‭with‬‭suspension‬ ‭orders‬ ‭and‬‭any‬‭possible‬‭violation‬‭of‬‭the‬‭BIS‬‭Act,‬‭2016‬‭and‬‭Rules,‬‭Regulations‬‭framed‬ ‭thereunder:‬

 (‭ a)‬ ‭No‬ ‭response‬ ‭received‬ ‭from‬ ‭the‬ ‭CoC‬ ‭holder‬ ‭within‬ ‭15‬ ‭days‬ ‭from‬ ‭the‬ ‭date‬ ‭of‬ ‭communication of necessary instructions by BIS - Visit within next 15 days.‬

 (‭ b)‬ ‭If‬ ‭there‬ ‭is‬ ‭still‬ ‭no‬ ‭response‬ ‭from‬ ‭the‬ ‭CoC‬‭holder‬‭after‬‭the‬‭visit,‬‭the‬‭case‬‭may‬‭be‬ ‭processed for initiating proceedings for cancellation.‬

 (‭ ii)‬ ‭In‬ ‭case‬ ‭of‬ ‭detection‬ ‭of‬ ‭misuse‬ ‭or‬ ‭any‬ ‭violation‬ ‭of‬ ‭the‬ ‭provisions‬ ‭of‬ ‭the‬ ‭BIS‬‭Act,‬ ‭2016‬ ‭and‬ ‭Rules,‬ ‭Regulations‬‭framed‬‭thereunder,‬‭further‬‭necessary‬‭action‬‭shall‬‭also‬‭be‬ ‭taken as per provisions.‬

‭11)‬ B ‭ efore‬ ‭cancelling‬ ‭a‬ ‭certificate‬ ‭of‬ ‭conformity,‬ ‭a‬ ‭cancellation‬ ‭notice‬ ‭of‬ ‭not‬ ‭less‬ ‭than‬ ‭twenty-one‬ ‭days‬ ‭shall‬ ‭be‬ ‭given‬ ‭(template‬ ‭attached‬ ‭Annexure‬ ‭-‬ ‭VI‬‭).‬ ‭Before‬ ‭issuing‬ ‭cancellation‬ ‭notice,‬ ‭the‬ ‭DDGR‬ ‭shall‬ ‭satisfy‬ ‭herself/himself‬ ‭about‬ ‭completeness‬ ‭of‬ ‭information‬‭and‬‭facts‬‭of‬‭the‬‭case.‬‭Where‬‭DDGR‬‭is‬‭satisfied‬‭that‬‭it‬‭is‬‭necessary‬‭to‬‭issue‬ ‭cancellation‬‭notice,‬‭she/he‬‭shall‬‭record‬‭the‬‭reasons‬‭while‬‭taking‬‭decision‬‭for‬‭issuance‬‭of‬ ‭cancellation notice.‬

 (‭ i)‬ ‭In‬ ‭case‬ ‭no‬ ‭reply‬ ‭is‬ ‭received‬ ‭within‬ ‭stipulated‬ ‭time,‬ ‭the‬ ‭certificate‬ ‭of‬ ‭conformity‬ ‭may be cancelled.‬

 (‭ ii)‬‭In‬‭case‬‭reply‬‭is‬‭received‬‭within‬‭stipulated‬‭time,‬‭it‬‭shall‬‭be‬‭examined‬‭and‬‭reviewed‬ ‭by‬ ‭the‬ ‭DDGR.‬ ‭Where‬ ‭the‬ ‭DDGR‬ ‭is‬ ‭satisfied‬ ‭that‬ ‭it‬ ‭is‬ ‭necessary‬ ‭to‬ ‭cancel‬ ‭the‬ ‭certificate‬ ‭of‬ ‭conformity,‬ ‭she/he‬ ‭shall‬ ‭record‬ ‭the‬ ‭reasons‬ ‭while‬ ‭taking‬ ‭decision‬ ‭for‬ ‭cancellation.‬

 (‭ iii)‬ ‭If‬ ‭the‬ ‭certificate‬ ‭of‬ ‭conformity‬ ‭is‬‭not‬‭cancelled,‬‭the‬‭matter‬‭shall‬‭be‬‭taken‬‭up‬‭for‬ ‭corrective actions and its verification as per applicable paras (9(ii)) of this document.‬

 ‭4‬

(‭ iv)‬ ‭The‬ ‭competent‬ ‭authority‬ ‭shall‬ ‭take‬ ‭into‬ ‭account‬ ‭merits‬ ‭of‬ ‭the‬ ‭case‬ ‭and‬ ‭facts‬ ‭presented‬‭by‬‭manufacturer‬‭during‬‭personal‬‭hearing‬‭and‬‭shall‬‭pass‬‭speaking‬‭orders‬‭for‬ ‭the final decision taken.‬
